## 🛠️ Automated Numerical Analysis & Algorithm Modeling {.unnumbered}

**Project Focus:** Assessing computational efficiency, numerical stability, and algorithmic error handling under extreme constraints.

* **Core Methodology:** Evaluated algebraic formulas against iterative numerical methods—specifically *Newton’s Method* and *Bisection Methods*—to isolate performance bottlenecks in high-magnitude processing environments.
* **Technical Application:** Engineered structured comparisons measuring convergence rates, precision decay, and execution speeds across contrasting operational frameworks.
* **Key Deliverable:** Documented engineering insights regarding memory stability and deterministic logic constraints under high coefficient strain.

## 📊 Predictive Population Modeling & Statistical Scripting {.unnumbered}

**Project Focus:** Utilizing automated statistical computation to ingest multi-variable health indicators, map data trends, and isolate high-probability predictive variables.

* **Core Methodology:** Developed comprehensive data processing scripts using **R Markdown** to run predictive logic on complex demographic data models.
* **Technical Application:** Applied rigorous statistical filtering and numerical logic frameworks to map multi-tiered dependencies and structural trends within raw datasets.
* **Key Deliverable:** Formulated a deployment-ready, fully reproducible modeling script that cleanly structures raw inputs into transparent, data-driven probability outputs.

👉 [**View the Statistical Modeling Project (PDF)**](assets/FinalProject.pdf)
